description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the ClaimEventAPI class, which is part of a Human Resource Management (HRM) system plugin. The test class 'ClaimEventAPITest' includes methods to test creating, retrieving all, retrieving one, updating, and deleting claim events, utilizing mock services and fixtures for integration testing.

classes.name: ClaimEventAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the ClaimEventAPI endpoints within the OrangeHRM HRM system plugin. It tests creating, fetching, updating, and deleting claim events using mock data and services.
